Type: deco
Name: Rivet Modern Tall Geometric Wire Baskets, Set of 2, 13.25"H and 10.75"H, Silver
Colors: Silver
These matching wire baskets are just the thing you've been looking for to bring a sense of functionality and modern art to your living space. Breathtaking empty or in use, they are the perfect modern addition to any room in your home. Large: 13.25"H x 17.75" diameter; small: 10.75"H x 13.25" diameter 2 nesting baskets formed of metal wire with a silver finish Useful for storing small items This stunning work of craftsmanship showcases the perfect marriage of functionality and grace. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
